question: How does the chief of the gaṇas personally fulfill his own excellent duty?
premises: He is the chief of the gaṇas.
He attends to his own duty himself.
He performs it for an excellent task.
inference: The chief of the gaṇas personally and diligently performs his own duty for an excellent purpose.
plain_english: The chief of the gaṇas, himself attending to and performing his own duty for an excellent purpose.
